dmc.name: Ozyo Global DMC
dmc.short: Professional DMC services for domestic and international operations.
dmc.description: Ozyo Global DMC provides comprehensive destination management services in Turkey and worldwide for tour operators and travel agencies. We manage all operational processes from accommodation to transfers, activities to city tours.

mice.name: Ozyo Global MICE
mice.short: End-to-end service for corporate events and incentive programs.
mice.description: Ozyo Global MICE provides end-to-end service for corporate clients in congresses, seminars, trade fairs, corporate meetings and incentive travel. We carefully plan every detail of your event and create flawless experiences.

production.name: Ozyo Global Production
production.tagline: Tourism Support for Film & Ad Productions
production.short: Accommodation, transport, visa and logistics for production teams.
production.description: Ozyo Global Production covers all travel and logistics needs for film, TV series and commercial production companies. We provide timely, reliable and flexible service even during intensive shooting schedules.

location.name: Ozyo Global Location
location.short: Event venues, filming locations and exclusive property rental.
location.description: Ozyo Global Location connects clients with the most prestigious venues across Turkey, especially Istanbul, for events and productions. With our extensive portfolio of hotels, restaurants, historic buildings and private properties, we find your dream venue.
